meta.description: What you arrange and bring, travel insurance, the medical and allergy details we need, difficulty grades, packing lists and what each trip includes.

head.title: Before you travel
head.lede: What to do at each step, from choosing a trip that suits your pace to packing your bag, and the health and insurance details we need from every guest.

essentials.title: Three things we need from every guest

enquire.title: When you enquire
enquire.intro: Choose a trip that suits your pace. On a private departure we can set the pace around your group.

book.title: When you book
book.intro: Three conditions of booking for every guest. Many of our routes are remote, and the nearest hospital can be hours away, so we plan the pace and our emergency response around what you tell us.

leave.title: Before you leave home
leave.intro: These you arrange and bring yourself. Each trip page lists what is included between its start and end points.

trip.title: On the trip
trip.intro: We use wildlife lodges, guesthouses and nature stays chosen for comfort and for being close to the field. Meals are included on every trip; tell us about any allergy or dietary need when you book.

health.notSure: Not sure whether a trip suits a health condition, an allergy or your mobility? Ask us before you book.
health.whatsappMessage: Hello Wildora, I have a health question before booking:

difficulty.title: Your pace
difficulty.none: No current fixed departure is graded {grade}. A private route can be, on request.

packing.title: What to pack
packing.intro: A general list for all our routes. Each <link>trip page</link> adds its own “What to bring” list for its season and terrain.
packing.hint: Tick things off as you pack. The ticks clear when you leave the page.

essential.title: Essential gear
items: Sturdy, broken-in walking shoes or boots with good grip
A rain jacket that is waterproof, not just water-resistant
Long trousers and full-sleeve shirts in neutral colours
A warm layer for early mornings and high ground
Headlamp or torch, with spare batteries

extras.title: Useful extras
items: Camera with a telephoto or macro lens, spare batteries and memory cards
Your own field guide (we carry shared references)
Power bank, and a plug adapter for Indian sockets (Types C, D and M; 230 V): power can be intermittent at remote lodges
Tissues, hand sanitiser and wet wipes for the road

included.title: What we arrange
included.notIncludedBody: Travel medical insurance, and everything under <link>Before you leave home</link>.
